notes: Source fixture SHA-256: 5e5b1d8f6e758929bbdf5fe7f4906523cae13de939ece1fcf681824ccfa2b4aa. Deterministic selection starts from source order, admits only non-witness rows whose flags are composed of P2SH, STRICTENC, or MINIMALDATA, and excludes signature, lock-time, SegWit, Taproot, and BTC-disabled/BSV-re-enabled opcode rows. From the remaining applicable rows it takes the first 140 expected successes and the first 60 failures in the supported error categories, then restores source order. No Go SDK data or oracle output is stored.
